Method of Attack: Info-stealing malware using steganography to hide encrypted binary code inside image files for unpacking
Steals browser information from over 25 products
Checks for remote administration tools (SSH, VNC, RDP)
Finds credentials for email and file transfer clients
Uses custom decryption method instead of common block cipher like AES
Persistence via autostart registry entries and Visual Basic script executed by wscript
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by use of %appdatalocal%, %temp%, registry, and wscript)
Attack Vector: Visual Basic script (VBS) executed by wscript
Malware unpacking via encrypted binary hidden in image files
Indicators of Compromise: Creation of directory in %appdatalocal% with Loki binary and image files
Autostart registry entries pointing to VB script
Use of image files containing encrypted binary for unpacking
